name: Duolingo TV Mode
description: Larger text and buttons on Duolingo for TV-based language learning

params.css: [class*='promotional'], [class*='premium'], [class*='promo-banner'] { display: none !important; } [data-test='challenge-translate-input'] { font-size: 22px !important; } [data-test='challenge-judge-text'] { font-size: 22px !important; line-height: 1.6 !important; } button[data-test] { font-size: 18px !important; padding: 14px 24px !important; } h1 { font-size: 28px !important; } .rwHAM { font-size: 20px !important; }
